scenes.name: comparison
scenes.text: This is a real Tinker fine-tuning experiment with Qwen three, eight B. On forty held-out synthetic examples, pipeline F one rose from point eight six five to point nine two five. Precision improved, but recall, owner accuracy, and measured latency regressed. These results do not establish real-world accuracy.

scenes.name: baseline
scenes.text: Here is one illustrative refusal, selected after evaluation. The baseline treated, Not this time, my answer is no, as a possible commitment. Its exact output is preserved alongside every other test response.

scenes.name: finetuned
scenes.text: The selected checkpoint returned an empty commitment list for the same refusal. That removes this false positive. The full comparison still includes the tuned model's mistakes and regressions.

scenes.name: consent
scenes.text: The normal application still uses local Ollama. This separate research preview accepts only frozen synthetic examples. Sending a source to Tinker requires an explicit checkbox for each import. The notes shown here were authored for the experiment.

scenes.name: inference
scenes.text: This import makes a fresh request to the actual saved checkpoint. It does not replay an extraction. The connection was warmed before recording, and scene holds support narration, so this video is not a latency benchmark.

scenes.name: review
scenes.text: Both models missed Cleo's migration guide commitment in this messy transcript. The suggestions they did find retain literal source quotes. In this simulated review, the person keeps the security sign-off condition visible and checks Dario's ownership. A matching quote establishes provenance, not correctness.

scenes.name: followup
scenes.text: Only after that review does the person approve the commitment and prepare a follow-up. The message stays editable. Nothing is sent automatically. The approval boundary remains part of PromiseKeeper, whichever model proposes the suggestion.

scenes.name: privacy
scenes.text: Cloud processing is disclosed here. Deleting a local source does not delete provider records. This checkpoint improved synthetic-test F one, but its owner and date regressions prevent production activation. The report, raw responses, training logs, and estimated token costs preserve the complete result.
